title: use-after-free in TextIOWrapper.tell() with a reentrant decoder
object: next_input, the borrowed snapshot bytes object
lifetime_ender: the decoder's getstate runs Python that seeks the file and replaces the snapshot
distinguishing: the freed object is a bytes snapshot of buffered input
size_note: a large buffer puts the snapshot above the 512-byte threshold, where the same defect is an ordinary malloc use-after-free that ASan sees. The driver pins the small size
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
